'''Glo-Long''' was a manufacturing company that produced [[Glowrod/Legends|glow sticks]]. It was widely considered the finest glow stick manufacturer in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Rumors existed that the company was using [[Radiation/Legends|radioactive]] waste in order to make their glow sticks last longer.
